entries.claim: The product owner authorized submitting the minimal desktop bootstrap handshake now, while keeping account authorization, balances, usage and tool-key management out of this change.

The desktop client owns a closed draft-2020-12 schema and recognized fixture for GET /api/desktop/v1/bootstrap with schema version 1, minimum client version 0.1.0 and six false capability declarations.
At baseline commit 33926b6c, the Gin API router has anonymous status and pricing routes but no /api/desktop/v1/bootstrap route.
